lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice arranging a plan that depends on a realistic condition with om.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Two colleagues decide whether to take a walk, eat out, or meet after work.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Making plans that depend on time, weather, or availability.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik make a simple social plan, but the plan depends on whether it rains or whether there is enough time.

main_focus.name: first conditional with om
main_focus.description: Use om plus present tense to describe a real condition and the likely result.
model_examples: Om det inte regnar, tar vi en promenad.
Om jag hinner, följer jag med.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use first conditional structures naturally 3-4 times in the dialogue.

avoid_grammar: hypothetical second conditional as the main focus

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use conditions around common social constraints, not complex hypotheticals.

dialogue_shape.opening: One person suggests a possible plan.
dialogue_shape.middle: They discuss one or two realistic conditions that affect the plan.
dialogue_shape.ending: They agree on the likely plan or decide to confirm later.

target_complexity.repetition: the om pattern should recur with different everyday conditions

focus: the condition that affects the plan
what plan is agreed or left open

sentence_focus: one sentence with om det regnar
one sentence with om jag hinner
one sentence with då as a result
one sentence suggesting a plan after work
one sentence saying they will decide later
